description: This file contains a Streamlit application that integrates with Google Generative AI's Gemini model to implement a Q&A chatbot interface. It includes multiple commented-out methods for different functionalities, but the active code initializes a Gemini chat model, configures API keys, and defines a function to get responses from the model, along with UI components for user interaction.

methods.name: get_gemini_response
methods.description: Sends a question to the Gemini chat model and returns the streamed response.
